name: How long does it take to trim out an entire basement?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to trim out an entire basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard basement trim package in an average home typically takes between one and three days to install. A small, open basement with basic door casings and simple baseboards can often be trimmed in a single day. Larger basements with partitioned bedrooms, egress window jamb extensions, closets, stair skirts, and crown molding require several days. If your project includes on-site caulking, patching nail holes, and multi-coat finish painting, plan for an extra day or two for proper dry times.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most basement trim projects take one to three days for carpentry installation, with additional time needed if on-site caulking and finish painting are included.
